$comment: Rites within the liturgical traditions. DRAFT, local vocabulary: CESIDR identifies the Churches sui iuris (esi:) and the liturgical traditions (trad:), but not the rites within a tradition — the Latin tradition alone comprises the Roman, Ambrosian, Hispano-Mozarabic and Bragan rites. This vocabulary belongs in CESIDR eventually and is kept here until it moves. A use within a rite (the Zaire Use of the Roman Rite) is not a rite: it is the `use` attribute of an edition. The `rite:` prefix is a placeholder pending the cross-registry prefix decision (CatholicOS/cdcf-uri-scheme#13).

entries.note: Proper to the Archdiocese of Milan and parts of the neighbouring dioceses.
Celebrated in the Mozarabic Chapel of Toledo Cathedral and on occasion elsewhere in Spain.
The Ge'ez family of the Alexandrian tradition, shared by the Ethiopian and Eritrean Catholic Churches; distinct from the Coptic family of the same tradition.
